parameters.name: PasswordExpirationAction
parameters.description:
The action to take upon password expiration. This parameter must be specified when PasswordExpirationStatus is set to enabled. Valid values:

*   forbid_login: Users cannot log on to IDaaS.
*   force_update_password: Users must change the password.
*   remind_update_password: IDaaS reminds users to change the password upon each logon.

parameters.name: PasswordExpirationNotificationChannels
parameters.description: The methods for receiving password expiration notifications. This parameter must be specified when PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus is set to enabled.

parameters.name: PasswordExpirationNotificationDuration
parameters.description: The number of days before the expiration date during which password expiration notifications are sent. Unit: day. This parameter must be specified when PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus is set to enabled.

parameters.name: PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the password expiration notification feature. Valid values:

*   enabled
*   disabled

parameters.name: PasswordExpirationStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the password expiration feature. Valid values:

*   enabled
*   disabled

parameters.name: PasswordForcedUpdateDuration
parameters.description: The number of days before which users must change the password to prevent password expiration. Unit: day. You must set this parameter to a value greater than the value of PasswordExpirationNotificationDuration.

parameters.name: PasswordValidMaxDay
parameters.description: The validity period of a password. Unit: day. This parameter must be specified when PasswordExpirationStatus is set to enabled.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam set-password-expiration-configuration --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --password-expiration-status enabled --password-valid-max-day 180 --password-expiration-action force_update_password --password-expiration-notification-status enabled --password-expiration-notification-channels login --password-expiration-notification-duration 7 --password-forced-update-duration 7 --effective-authentication-source-ids ia_passwordxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam SetPasswordExpirationConfiguration --region cn-hangzhou --PasswordExpirationStatus enabled --PasswordExpirationNotificationChannels.1 login --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --PasswordForcedUpdateDuration 7 --EffectiveAuthenticationSourceIds.1 ia_passwordxxxx --PasswordValidMaxDay 180 --PasswordExpirationNotificationDuration 7 --PasswordExpirationAction force_update_password --PasswordExpirationNotificationStatus enabled --method POST --force
